blocks.x: Fulfillment is throughput economics: pick rates, dock scheduling, labor allocation and inventory truth. Orchestrated robots, vision-verified quality and agentic labor planning compound into cost-per-order leadership.

The workflows we industrialize here: Slotting and pick-path, Wave/order batching, Labor planning, Dock scheduling, Inventory accuracy. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Cycle-count programs lag; phantom stock breaks promises.
Shift planning vs. volume waves manual; overtime and missed SLAs.
Slotting decisions quarterly; travel waste permanent.
Cost per order by process unknown; improvements guessed.
